categories.main_business_segments: CEC Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. primarily operates in ecological environment governance, focusing on three main segments: water treatment (industrial and municipal wastewater treatment, water environment governance), solid and hazardous waste treatment (including sludge coupling treatment, soil remediation, kitchen waste treatment, hazardous waste disposal), and flue gas treatment (including desulfurization, denitrification, dust removal, VOCs treatment). The company also develops high-end equipment manufacturing and smart environmental protection solutions, providing integrated system solutions, engineering contracting, facility operation, and project investment services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as zero-discharge wastewater treatment, nanofiltration membrane separation, full membrane water treatment, sludge drying coupling treatment, and advanced flue gas treatment technologies including CCFB semi-dry desulfurization and HTR-3SO denitrification. It integrates R&D, core equipment manufacturing, system integration, EPC contracting, and smart operation platforms. The company also develops digital and intelligent environmental protection platforms using industrial internet, IoT, AI, and big data technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CEC Environmental Protection serves key industrial sectors including power generation (nuclear, thermal), petrochemical, metallurgy, coal chemical, new energy, coal mining, and building materials, as well as municipal and industrial parks. Its customers include major national industrial enterprises and government entities. The company has expanded its market presence domestically across China and internationally in Asia, Europe, Africa, the Americas, especially Belt and Road countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive projects across multiple provinces and cities including Jiangsu, Henan, Ningxia, Guangdong, Shandong, and others. It also has international operations in Asia, Europe, Africa, and the Americas, focusing on Belt and Road initiative countries. Its subsidiaries and projects cover urban and industrial regions domestically and selected overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: CEC Environmental Protection operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain, providing integrated environmental governance solutions including technology development, equipment manufacturing, engineering contracting (EPC/EP), facility operation and maintenance, and project investment. It acts as a system integrator and service provider rather than a raw material supplier or end consumer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in zero-discharge water treatment, membrane technologies, sludge drying coupling, soil and groundwater remediation, flue gas ultra-low emission technologies, and digital smart environmental platforms. It emphasizes innovation through industry-academia collaboration, technology incubation, and industrial innovation platforms. Key R&D projects include salt lake lithium extraction, high ammonia nitrogen wastewater treatment, industrial wastewater monitoring systems, and advanced desulfurization and denitrification technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through engineering contracting (EPC, EP, BOT, EPCO), sales of environmental protection equipment, facility operation and maintenance services, and project investments. The company recognizes revenue from construction contracts based on progress, product sales, and service fees. It also earns investment income from equity investments and financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CEC Environmental Protection is a leading player in China's ecological environment governance industry with a strong market position in industrial water treatment, municipal wastewater treatment, sludge coupling treatment, and flue gas treatment. It competes with other national and regional environmental service providers and technology firms. The company holds multiple national-level certifications and has a recognized brand with extensive project experience and technological capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 837 million, a 16.77% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 74 million, down 13.58%. Total assets were around RMB 2.7 billion with net assets of RMB 1.88 billion. The company maintains a stable but slightly declining revenue and profit trend amid intense market competition, with significant cash flow from operations and ongoing investments in innovation and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CEC Environmental Protection emphasizes its integrated system solutions combining advanced proprietary technologies, comprehensive service capabilities, and strong project execution. Its differentiation lies in zero-discharge wastewater treatment, membrane separation technologies, sludge drying coupling, ultra-low emission flue gas treatment, and smart environmental management platforms. The company leverages its innovation platform, strong R&D, and extensive industry experience to deliver high-quality, efficient, and sustainable environmental governance services, supporting clients' green transformation and carbon neutrality goals.
